entries.text: Tracker created and seeded with initial research for 9 schools. Most dates are last cycle's (carried_from_2026) — the first refresh will confirm 2027 dates as schools publish them (Aug–Oct 2026).

Added Marymount → Northeastern University – New York City. The MMC/Northeastern merger completed July 9–10, 2026; the dance BFA continues as a 4-year NYC program, but application/audition mechanics are mid-transition — watch nyc.northeastern.edu.
